label: extension

args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Emma Johnson, and I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo for a party of 10 people.

I would like to enquire about your availability for the month of June 2024. Could you please let me know:

1. Which dates in June 2024 you have availability for a group of 10 guests?
2. What room types and configurations would be available for a group of this size?
3. Any group booking rates or discounts you may offer?

I look forward to hearing from you and would be happy to provide any additional information you may need.

Thank you very much for your time and assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
args.subject: Group Booking Enquiry - Availability for 10 People in June
